inlines.v: PROMIS'CUOUS, adjective [Latin promiscuus; pro and misceo, to mix.] 1. Mingled; consisting of individuals united in a body or mass without order; confused; undistinguished; as a promiscuous crowd or mass. A wild where weeds and flow'rs promiscuous shoot. 2. Common; indiscriminate; not restricted to an individual; as promiscuous love or intercourse.
